title: Communications Provisioning Platform - Migadu to Mac/iOS Client Provisioning

source_context.problem_to_fix: Prior scope was incorrectly narrowed to five canonical mailboxes. Required scope is every mailbox in Migadu, with provider inventory, generated client configuration, validation artefacts and receipts.
known_evidence: Migadu PATCH forwarding_to was validated on existing mailbox with HTTP 200 in prior run
atlas forwarding for multiple domains showed confirmed_at timestamps from 2026-06-28 to 2026-06-30 in pasted output
catchall PATCH was reported as succeeded for 11 target domains in pasted output
iPhone SMTP sender-address-not-valid issue remained unresolved and is out of scope for Mac-only generation unless device credentials are later verified

objective: Build a source-of-truth communications provisioning platform that discovers Migadu domains, mailboxes, aliases, forwarders and catchalls, then generates complete Mac/iOS mail configuration artefacts, inventory, validation reports and receipts.

scope.mailbox_scope: ALL mailboxes discoverable from Migadu API, not a hard-coded subset
scope.domain_scope: ALL domains discoverable from Migadu API

execution_sequence.name: Discover Migadu estate
actions: Read Migadu credentials from runtime environment only
List all domains
List mailboxes per domain
List aliases, forwarders and catchall destinations where supported
Write canonical JSON inventory

execution_sequence.name: Normalize canonical communications model
actions: Create Organisation > Domain > Mailbox > Alias > Forwarding > Catchall graph
Attach owner/status/evidence/dependency/lifecycle fields
Classify mailbox type: user, shared, forwarder, catchall-target, service, unknown

execution_sequence.name: Generate client configuration
actions: Generate macOS Apple Mail .mobileconfig
Generate iOS/iPadOS .mobileconfig
Use full email address as username
Use SSL/TLS IMAP and SMTP settings
Avoid embedding plaintext passwords unless explicitly supplied through secure local runtime

execution_sequence.name: Generate audit artefacts
actions: Generate CSV and JSON inventory
Generate HTML inventory
Generate validation report
Generate receipt.json with counts, timestamps, source API status and warnings

execution_sequence.name: Validate
actions: Check every discovered domain has DNS/mail policy status recorded
Check every mailbox has IMAP/SMTP/account status where available
Check aliases point to real destinations where discoverable
Check catchall targets exist
Check forwarding destinations and confirmation status where available
Flag missing, stale or unverified items rather than assuming success

non_goals: Do not manually hard-code five canonical accounts as the final scope
Do not claim Mac installation is complete until the profile is generated and installed with observable local receipt
Do not store Migadu API token in repository
Do not require HITL except for credentials, destructive changes, or device-local installation confirmation
acceptance_criteria: Every Migadu domain appears in domains.json
Every Migadu mailbox appears in mailboxes.json and mailboxes.csv
Every generated profile account maps back to a discovered mailbox record
Validation report includes counts and explicit gaps
Receipt includes generated artefact paths, counts, timestamp and execution environment
No success is marked REAL without commit/runtime/local installation receipt
current_gap: GitHub commission is receipted by commit. Runtime execution and Mac installation still require endpoint worker execution with Migadu credentials available outside chat.
next_action: Worker or Mac endpoint should pull this bundle, run discovery/generation scripts, and return dist/receipt.json plus validation-report.html.
